title: Add docs/system-facts.md to planner and critic briefs with drift test
summary: Create a short sourced docs/system-facts.md of run-time facts the code can't reveal (including the user's added facts), embed it in planner_brief and critic_brief, and add a budgets test failing when recorded budgets/sizes drift from computed ones. Audience: planner and critic agents, and maintainers editing the file.

defaults_applied.how: Unit test in briefs.rs and drift test in budgets.rs; cargo test and clippy clean.
Every fact in the file cites a source.
Tests check brief output contains the file and that a doctored budget is rejected.
No emails or secrets; SSH remote example uses a placeholder.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: The file is embedded via include_str! in briefs.rs so both briefs carry it.
Budget numbers are recorded in a parseable form (e.g. 'reader: 1997 of 2000') so the test can extract them.
The facts file may need to fit within the planner/critic budgets; if it does not, budgets in budgets.rs are not raised without need and the file is kept short.
Boundary words are not listed; the file points to boundary_words() in xtask/tests/policy.rs as the source.
No athena.toml or workflow change is needed; the [personal_data] allow-list is only referenced.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/system-facts.md is short and states every requested and added fact (squash-merge/linear history/up-to-date branches; producer one-commit snapshot; plain copy without git or records/ for reader, planner, critic; prompt sets with budgets and current sizes; plan request format; land lands only a job's PR; records on athena/records after C0; SSH remote refused at admission; per-PR and per-branch caches; early PR and land waiting for CI), each with a source.
The file does not list the banned boundary words and names boundary_words() in xtask/tests/policy.rs as the source; no email-like text appears in it.
A briefs.rs unit test asserts planner_brief and critic_brief output contains the facts file text; run `cargo test -p athena-context`.

A budgets.rs test fails when the budgets or current sizes recorded in the file differ from the computed ones, and a negative case with a doctored value is rejected; run `cargo test -p athena-cli --test budgets`.
The existing planner and critic budget tests still pass with the file included; run `cargo test -p athena-cli --test budgets`.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry and docs/decisions.md records the call (file, brief inclusion, drift test).
cargo test, cargo clippy and cargo fmt --check pass at the repository root.

out_of_scope: Listing the banned words in the file
departures: Slightly higher cost: the file must fit within tight prompt budgets (reader 1997/2000) and needs a parser test.
